field: Science and technology experiments for test flights
description_short: The NASA TechRise Student Challenge invites student teams in grades 6-12 to propose a science or technology experiment for a NASA-supported test flight. A teacher or school employee submits proposals via Future Engineers. Winners are expected in January 2027, with flights in summer 2027.
status_evidence: NASA challenge page and Future Engineers (administrator) both give proposals due 2 November 2026, 11:59 PM PT (future)
